product.olivetti-echos-p120e.summary: The Echos P120E paired the modular bay with a 11.3-inch TFT display.
product.olivetti-echos-p120e.history: Windows Magazine placed the P120E in the North American multimedia line in October 1996. It listed US$3,799 and described initial assembly in Taiwan and final configuration in Spokane.
product.olivetti-echos-p120e.architectur: The bay let users adapt the notebook to their work. The range used PCI and accepted a 6× CD-ROM, floppy drive or second battery in that bay.
product.olivetti-echos-p120e.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p120e.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p120e.review: Windows Magazine, October 1996, They’re Coming to America.
